research_questions: What are the most significant technical breakthroughs in CRISPR variants (e.g., Cas12, Cas13, Cas14) over the last 12-18 months?
What is the current status of prime editing and base editing in clinical or pre-clinical stages?
How has the recent FDA approval of CRISPR-based therapies (like Casgevy) changed the landscape?
What advancements have been made in minimizing off-target effects and improving precision?
What are the latest developments in non-viral delivery systems for CRISPR components?
decision_criteria: Efficiency of delivery to target tissues
Scalability of the technology for therapeutic use
success_criteria: A comprehensive summary of 2023-2024 technical milestones.
Clear distinction between different editing modalities (Base vs. Prime vs. Standard).
Update on clinical trial outcomes and regulatory approvals.
missing_information: Specific area of interest (e.g., human therapeutics, agriculture, or industrial biotechnology).
The desired level of technical complexity (e.g., academic/professional vs. general overview).
assumptions: The user is interested in the most recent developments (roughly the last 1-2 years).
The focus is primarily on medical and therapeutic applications unless otherwise specified.
